observations.explanation: The paper presents a four-module framework and says most prior studies can be viewed as instances of it (PDF pp. 2–3); it also maps representative systems to the taxonomy in Table 1 (p. 12), supporting its usefulness for comparison.
The survey explicitly covers construction, applications, and evaluation (PDF pp. 2, 14, 19), and separately summarizes learning strategies (pp. 3, 12–14), supporting the stated breadth.

The authors describe the field as being at its initial stage and identify challenges (PDF p. 22). Characterizing this as bounding the maturity of the survey’s conclusions and directions is a reasonable, qualified implication.

The paper says it compiled 100 relevant works (PDF p. 22), but the supplied text does not provide reproducible search sources, dates, or inclusion/exclusion criteria. The observation presents this as a coverage uncertainty, not a proven defect.
